source_full_text: So the guards left him alone and he stuck up his long stick near the well, Hung his cloak round the stick and put his hat on the top. He also hung his knapsack up inside the cloak so that it might seem to have some body within it.
target_trajectory: 于是守卫们把他撂在一边，他便留了下来。
他把长棍子靠在井边，把斗篷挂在上面。
他把帽子放在棍子顶端。
